title: eludite.resx.validate input
description: Run the consistency rules over a resource set (proposal 0005 section 2; the settings `resx.rules.*` switch each off): the warnings the editor shows on cells and under its Warnings filter. Read: nothing is written.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.

cultures.description: Only these cultures. Default: every culture file of the set (the neutral file has no warnings of its own).

items.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.
